The '''Savrip Shore''' was a region of beach on the northern coast of [[Avilatan]], an island on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Ord Mantell/Legends|Ord Mantell]]; [[Savrip Island]] was off the coast of Savrip Shore.
